summary: EFCAR, LLC, as depositor and equity holder, filed an 8-K reporting a Capital Contribution Agreement dated September 15, 2026, with Exeter Finance LLC and Exeter Automobile Receivables Trusts 2022-2 through 2022-5, acknowledged by Citibank, N.A., as indenture trustee. The agreement permits EFCAR to make limited capital contributions to the trusts. No stake, price, premium, or deal terms were disclosed. This is a routine structural agreement for existing auto-loan ABS trusts, not a special situation. Watch for any impact on trust performance or noteholder collateral.
